items: o Deendayal Upadhyay Grameen Kaushalya Yojana (DDU-GKY): Skill training and market-
based employment for rural youth (15-35 years).
o Aajeevika Gramin Express Yojana: Safe, affordable rural transport via SHG-operated vehicles.
o Start-Up Entrepreneurship Programme: Encouraging local rural entrepreneurship.
o Rural Self Employment Training Institutes (RSETIs): Training for individuals aged 18-45.
o 91 lakh SHGs formed, mobilizing 9.9 crore women.
o SHG products sold on Meesho.
o Significant improvements in rural financial inclusion and livelihood opportunities.
o Applicable across all states and union territories (except Delhi and Chandigarh).
